EXTERNAL DATA
Project: INX Future Inc Employee Performance
Purpose:
This folder is used to store datasets, reference files, or supporting information obtained from third-party or external sources that may be used during the project.
Contents:
No external datasets were used for the current project.
The employee performance dataset used for this project is maintained separately in the data/raw/ folder.
If external data is added in the future, it should be stored in this folder along with information about:
•	Data source
•	Dataset name
•	Date obtained
•	Description of the data
•	License or usage restrictions, if applicable
•	Purpose of using the data
Data Management:
External data should not be directly modified. Any cleaned or transformed version should be saved in the data/processed/ folder.
